thread:
mike_infra: Heads-up — we need to run a week-long eval on the new Llama variant starting Mon. Target: 3 concurrent workers, each on A100 80GB, region us-west1. Want to reserve capacity now, not last-minute. Anyone know spare quota or any reservations we can borrow?

sophia_prod: What’s the expected throughput/latency profile? if it’s mostly batched we might fit into 48GB shapes with quantization.

mike_infra: Batch profile is large-context (32k tokens), so memory is the blocker. Tokens/sec roughly 120k combined. Preferred is A100-80GB for KV cache headroom. Fallback to 48GB quantized model is possible but needs a build test.

raj_gpu: I’ll check cloud quotas and current Dedicated pool. quick check command I used before: `gcloud compute regions describe us-west1 --project=redwood-inference` — running now.

jenna_procurement: FYI I’ve got a contact at MegaCloud and can request short-term capacity asap. Budget OK for a short reservation assuming we keep it <= 7 days. Do we want On-Demand or committed? Preemptible is risky for this run.

raj_gpu: Quick update: GCP quotas show project limit 20 A100_80, in-use 15 → free 5. However 2 of those are tied to Dedicated pool in production (not movable). Net available for this job = 3. Azure westus2 reports 0 free A100-80 slots today. So we’re short by 0-2 depending on prod reservations. If we need 3 exclusive, we’re about 1 short.

mike_infra: OK — given that, we can drop to 2 workers to start and scale to 3 if procurement gets capacity. Can we reserve the 2 we do have?

raj_gpu: I can create a soft reservation on GCP and tag it for your project. I’ll also open a vendor ticket for two additional GPUs — @jenna_procurement can you push on the vendor side for 2 A100-80 increase in us-west1?

jenna_procurement: On it. I’ll ask for short-term burst capacity (2 x A100-80) for the week starting Mon. Also asking for price for 7-day committed vs short-term on-demand. Will report back in this thread.

mike_infra: Thanks. Also planning a canary run Wed night off-peak — I’ll post runbook here and add access for @sophia_prod. Please flag if you want alerting on preemptions or scheduler evictions.

sophia_prod: Add me to the runbook please. Also set an alert if job runtime increases >25% vs baseline. :thumbsup:

raj_gpu: Reservation created: `resv-usw1-eval-1745` for 2 A100-80 (soft). Vendor ticket #MC-3821 created, awaiting confirmation. I’ll follow up if anything changes.

deploy-bot: [automation] Reminder: if reservation becomes active, update routing in `deploy/infra/gpu_pools` to include `resv-usw1-eval-1745`.

mike_infra: Great — thanks everyone. I’ll reduce initial workers to 2 and keep this thread updated.
